sentences.en: Demand for imported cars is increasing due to lower prices.
sentences.zh: 由于价格降低，进口汽车的需求正在增加。

sentences.en: Our life depends largely on oil imported from other countries.
sentences.zh: 我们的生活很大程度上依赖于其他国家进口的石油。

sentences.en: Auto imports will take a nose-dive in the first quarter.
sentences.zh: 第一季度汽车进口量将大幅下滑。

senses.zh: 输入；进口，进口货；意思，含义；重要性
